summary: Upload a file for a page import
description:
The raw file is the request body (application/octet-stream, streamed, at most 200 MB); there is no JSON body. It is kept for 30 minutes, for the user who uploaded it, until POST /backups/import/{id}/open opens it. Automatic backups cannot be imported (not-importable). Errors carry a backup.error.<code> message id: invalid-types (unknown kind), not-a-backup, invalid-archive, newer-format, too-large (413), not-importable.

Needs: manage on the section of the chosen kind (Proxy Hosts, Redirection Hosts, 404 Hosts, Streams, Access Lists or Certificates; DNS credentials use Certificates)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: The page kind the file is imported on

requestBody.description: The exported file, as raw bytes

200.description: The upload id, what the file says it holds and whether it needs a passphrase

id.description: The upload id; use it with POST /backups/import/{id}/open.

summary.description: What the file says it holds, read from its header; null when it has none.

encrypted.description: The file needs its passphrase to be opened
